item.title: A solution to the laser source bottleneck for DWDM copackaged optics?
item.description: Scintil Photonics and Tower Semiconductor produce the world’s first heterogeneously integrated photonics dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) laser sources—moving DWDM beyond a lab curiosity to a commercial product that can be manufactured at scale today on the same lines as tens of millions of pluggable optical transceivers.

item.title: PODCAST: Interview with Patrick Heissler, CEO of SCRONA
item.description: This episode of Following the Photons: A Photonics Podcast features Dr. Patrick Heissler, CEO of SCRONA, a microfabrication technology provider.

item.title: What if optical cavities stop resonating?
item.description: A novel Fabry-Pérot cavity incorporating a holographic phase mask demonstrates resonance-free operation by driving an unrestricted orbital-angular-momentum ladder-up process, which enables broadband transmission from a high-Q cavity.

item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 20, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A highly sensitive biosensor detects trace cancer biomarkers, this week's photonics business news roundup, and an ultrafast switching mirror device has use as an optical transistor.

item.title: Materials beyond silicon photonics emerge for scalable quantum photonic systems
item.description: The shift beyond silicon photonics is an expansion of the photonic materials toolkit. While silicon remains valuable for electronic-photonic integration and certain passive functions, scalable quantum photonic systems demand materials engineered specifically for quantum performance.

item.title: PODCAST: Interview with Lewis Johnson, cofounder and CTO of NLM Photonics
item.description: This episode of Following the Photons: A Photonics Podcast features Lewis Johnson, cofounder and CTO of NLM Photonics.

item.title: Tariff refund: Chase it, or chalk it up?
item.description: Let us know if the recent U.S. Supreme Court decision will prompt your company to pursue a refund of tariffs paid.

item.title: Thermoelectric coolers prevent thermal drift within compact optical systems
item.description: Thermoelectric coolers provide precision temperature control for lasers, detectors, and integrated photonics—where addressing thermal drift at the device level is essential.

item.title: Gamechanger: A polymer infrared thermal imaging lens
item.description: Traditional lenses made of germanium tend to cost hundreds or thousands of dollars and can’t be repaired when damaged—but a lower-cost sulfur polymer lens option is about to become a gamechanger for infrared (IR) thermal imaging cameras because it can be mass produced, repaired, and recycled.

item.title: Photonics Hot List: February 27, 2026
item.description: In this episode: A new approach bridges optical fiber and integrated photonics, this week's photonics business headlines, and researchers develop a method for neuron circuit mapping.
